digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter outbound comment send path
propositions: Jira DataCenter send path passes comment bodies to the client unfitted, bypassing _DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment which has no production caller
Over-length comments decorated with RECONCILER_MARKER are rejected by Jira DC and re-emitted on every pass because the send path does not fit to deployment-resolved comment_max_chars() ceiling
_DCSanitizer.fit_comment does not derive the dedup key from the marker-stripped fitted body actually sent, breaking e339 convergence consistency
The dead Cloud _JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment method applies a plain 32,767-char cap that would truncate RECONCILER_MARKER if wired, reintroducing bug 5931

JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment must route through _DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment with fit_preserving_marker composition to match Cloud's send-side behavior and preserve markers under ceiling constraints
